_doc: Side A manga grid, read RIGHT TO LEFT, top to bottom. Edited by hand; scripts/build_layout.py reads it.
Units: mm from the TRIM top-left corner (trim is 50 x 100; usable area 2.5..47.5 x 2.5..97.5; safe zone 3..47 x 3..97).
Each panel: 'box' [x, y, w, h] or 'poly' [[x, y], ...] for a slanted panel (the image fills the polygon's bounding box).
'img' defaults to assets/panels/<id>.png. Any size works: the real pixel size is read at build time, so a new image
only has to be dropped in at that path. 'focal' [fx, fy] is the point of the image (0..1 of its width/height) that is
kept as close to the panel centre as the crop allows; 'zoom' > 1 crops tighter around it (default 1 = just cover).
'sfx': 'at' [fx, fy] is the text centre as a fraction of the panel's bounding box; size is the font size in mm.

panels.beat: entrance, real YOKO ONO sign (never crop the sign)
the cut (1:1 source, slanted gutter on the left)
REVEAL: push pop on the red cushion (never crop the tube)
